skill_name: Edit a rough draft of a paper on solar system astronomy.
workflow: The earliest documented observations of the Solar System date back to prehistoric times, with astronomers observing the celestial bodies and patterns of their movements. This resulted in the formation of theories and the eventual mapping of the Solar System. Different features of the planets such as their appearance and orbits lent evidence to the realization that there was something unique about them.
